Chamber Volume in Litres (L): 1 L, 2 L, 3 L, 5 L, 6 L, 10 L, 15 L, 20 L, 25 L, 30 L, 50 L, 60 L, 75 L, 100 L, 250 L, 500 L | Working Temperature in Degree Celsius (°C): 0 to 1200°C | Temperature Control: Microprocessor Based PID | Temperature Accuracy in Degree Celsius (°C): ± 1°C, ± 2°C | Heating element: Kanthal (Iron-Chromium-Aluminum alloy), Nichrome (Nickel-Chromium alloy), Silicon Carbide (SiC) rods, Molybdenum Disilicide (MoSi?) rod, Magnetron | Chamber Construction: Triple walled with air insulation | Communication Port: RS 485, RS 232, USB, WIFI | Cooling: Natural cooling, Forced air cooling, Water cooling
